cases.sentence: — 15 Ведь Я призываю все народы ___, — возвещает Господь. –
cases.explain: «северных царств» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

cases.sentence: Сегодня Я сделал тебя укрепленным городом, ___ и бронзовой стеной, чтобы дать отпор всей этой земле — царям Иудеи, его приближенным, священникам и народу этой страны.
cases.explain: «железной колонной» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: For, behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

cases.explain: «бронзовой стеной» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: For, behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
